title: Endless Mayfly
excerpt: Iran-aligned network that faked articles on lookalike news sites, pushed them through bogus personas, then deleted them; exposed by Citizen Lab in 2019.
excerptEs: Red alineada con Irán que publicaba artículos falsos en webs que imitaban a medios reales, los difundía con identidades ficticias y luego los borraba; Citizen Lab la destapó en 2019.

sources.title: Burned After Reading: Endless Mayfly's Ephemeral Disinformation Campaign (Citizen Lab, University of Toronto, May 2019)
Endless Mayfly: an invasive species in the social media ecosystem (Ronald Deibert, Citizen Lab director, May 2019)
How Pro-Iran Hackers Spoofed FP and the News Media (Foreign Policy, May 2019)
